movie.title: The African Queen
movie.overview: At the start of the First World War, in the middle of Africa’s nowhere, a gin soaked riverboat captain is persuaded by a strong-willed missionary to go down river and face-off a German warship.

facts: Did you know the screenplay for 'The African Queen' was a true collaborative effort? It had four credited writers: James Agee, director John Huston, John Collier, and Peter Viertel!
Beyond the famous director and stars, the film was brought to the screen by producers Sam Spiegel and John Woolf. It's also an adaptation of a C. S. Forester novel first published way back in 1935!

The film's stunning visuals were captured in Technicolor by cinematographer Jack Cardiff, a key behind-the-scenes talent. And setting the perfect mood was Allan Gray, who composed the film's music score.
